_meta.purpose: Compare thinking-on vs thinking-off latency/token counts
_meta.recommendation: Keep gemini-2.5-flash + thinking disabled (~0.37s vs ~2.7s default). flash-lite returns 404 for new users. NIM: keep nemotron + enable_thinking=false (~6.8s vs ~9s); meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct timed out at 25s and is not a faster alternative. Per-target timeouts (Google 10s, NIM 18s) + strategy 408 failover remain required.
